Alongside the ongoing deal on AirPods 4 at nearly 25% off and the best price ever on Apple’s new AirTag 2, today’s 9to5Toys Lunch Break is headlined by the last remaining chances to land pre-price hike deals on M5 iPad Pro – this 1TB 13-inch is now $420 off. We also have M5 MacBook Air at $150 under the new prices at Apple, several Apple Watch Ultra 3 models at nearly $100 off, and a series of notable deals on Anker charging gear – latest 3-in-1 Qi2 25W foldable MagSafe Charging Station back at Prime Day all-time low, its 45W Nano charger with smart display down to just $26, and this notable discount on its display-equipped Qi2 25W smart MagSafe charger. Head below for a closer look.

Amazon offering Apple’s AirPods 4 at nearly 25% off

Best deal ever on Apple’s latest AirTag 2 is still rolling ($22 each)

With competitor 4th of July sales mostly all long gone now, and Prime Day well behind us, we wanted to touch down this morning to highlight the ongoing all-time low you can land on Apple’s latest 2nd generation AirTag – the 4-pack of Apple’s AirTag 2 is still sitting down at Amazon all-time low pricing.

Amazon is offering the AirTag 2 4-pack down at $89 shipped. This is the lowest price we have ever tracked and the same deal we spotted during Prime Day this year.

Considering the 4-pack already delivers a slight discount on a per AirTag basis even when at full price – a single AirTag is $29 and the 4-pack is effectively $25, this ongoing deal is actually even better than it might seem.

  • AirTag 2 $27 (Reg. $29)
  • AirTag (4-pack) $89 (Reg. $99) – Amazon all-time low

AirTag 2 has seen almost no discounts outside of these Prime Day offers, and this 4-pack at $89 (or $22 per AirTag 2) delivers the best per-Tag price we have tracked on brand new units anywhere.

As mentioned above, competitor sales that were also offering this deal are mostly long gone now, so Amazon really doesn’t have all that much incentive to keep this lingering Prime Day deal live for much longer. If you’re looking to land a bundle of Apple’s latest item trackers this summer, chances are this will be the best price we see in that timeframe and it might not be around for much longer.

Upgraded Ultra Wideband and Bluetooth chips for better range, a speaker that is 50% louder, and “expanded Precision Finding connectivity,” highlight the upgraded feature set here.

Pre-price hike deals still live on M5 iPad Pro: 1TB 13-inch now $420 off, more

As most of us already know by now, Apple has increased the price on its latest MacBook and iPad lineups. While much of it has now hit Amazon and other retailers where the best deals are, the M5 iPad Pro is still holding strong with pre-price hike deals. Some configurations have jumped up, but you can still score $300 off the most affordable 13-inch model and as much as $420 off some of the others.

Amazon is currently offering the 256GB 13-inch M5 iPad Pro down at $1,199.99 shipped. Now carrying a regular $1,499 list, this is just shy of $300 off the new sticker price and still down at the Prime Day price it was offered for ahead of the official increases.

Much of the same analysis can be applied to several other models in the lineup – some of these machines have sold for less than this in the past, but with prices now much higher we are looking at some serious deals here. The 1TB 13-inch model is as much as $420 off right now.

It might only be a matter of time before all of them jump way up like we have seen on the MacBooks and other iPad models:

M5 iPad Pro 11-inch:

  • 11-inch M5 iPad Pro 256GB $949 (Now Reg. $1,199)
  • 11-inch M5 iPad Pro 1TB $1,449 (Now Reg. $1,799)
  • 11-inch M5 iPad Pro 2TB $1,949 (Now Reg. $2,299)

M5 iPad Pro 13-inch:

  • 13-inch M5 iPad Pro 256GB $1,199 (Now Reg. $1,499)
  • 13-inch M5 iPad Pro 1TB $1,680 (Now Reg. $2,099) – $420 off the new list price
  • 13-inch M5 iPad Pro 2TB $2,249 (Now Reg. $2,599)

Don’t pay the jacked up prices at Apple: M5 MacBook Air is $150 less at Amazon right now

Price hikes have landed on the latest M5 MacBook Air lineup, and there’s no telling when they will let up, if ever. However, folks looking to land a new Air this summer can still avoid paying the newer higher prices at Apple nonetheless, as Amazon does have several configurations at $150 off right now.

Price hikes suck, but it is what it is and if you need a new Air right now Amazon is, at least, offering some price relief here. These are the three configurations you can land at $150 under the newer higher price tags at Apple – we recommend staying away from the others right now until we see the prices come down much lower from the new MSRPs:

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB from $1,449 (Reg. $1,599)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB from $1,349 (Reg. $1,499)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB from $1,649 (Reg. $1,799)

We did everything we could to highlight these machines once Apple jacked up the prices up, and before those higher prices subsequently landed on Amazon and elsewhere. But if you weren’t ready to pull the trigger and need a machine this summer/this year, you, at least, do not have to pay those prices you see straight from Apple now. You could try to wait this thing out, but there’s really no indication Apple is going to be reverting back to the previous prices at all this year, or ever at this point.

Several Apple Watch Ultra 3 models are nearly $100 off at Amazon today

To start the week off we are getting another shot at some rare price drops on Apple Watch Ultra 3 – you’ll now find the one-size fits most configs at just shy of $100 off at Amazon alongside the Milanese models in both case colors, and more. Scope out the details below.

Amazon is now offering Apple Watch Ultra 3 down at $699.99 shipped. This includes both the Titanium Black case model and the Natural variant with the matching one-size Ocean Bands in black and Anchor Blue.

These two configs also join the $99 price drops now live on both Milanese Loop setups and this Natural model with the latest Blue Trail Loop

  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 w/ Black Ocean Band $699 (Reg. $799)
  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 w/ Black Milanese Loop $799 (Reg. $899)
  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 3 w/ Anchor Blue Ocean Band $699 (Reg. $799)
  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 3 w/ Blue Trail Loop $699 (Reg. $799)
  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 3 w/ Natural Milanese Loop $799 (Reg. $899)

While did see all of these Ultra 3 models at $149 off for Prime Day this year, deals on Apple’s latest top-end wearable have largely been hard to come by since release. If you missed out a couple weeks ago, these deals are on par with the best we have tracked otherwise – we have only seen them selling for less than we are here today once on Amazon since last September’s launch and they have really only been on sale at all a small handful of times in that time frame.

Anker’s latest 3-in-1 Qi2 25W foldable MagSafe Charging Station back at Prime Day all-time low (35% off)

Alongside a host of deals on a range of its latest Smart Display wall chargers, 25W MagSafe stands, power banks, and more from $26 or less, the official Anker Amazon storefront is now offering its latest 3-in-1 Prime Foldable 25W Qi2.2 MagSafe Charger down at one of the lowest prices we have tracked to date with nearly 35% in savings.

Anker’s Amazon store is now offering its 3-in-1 Prime Foldable 25W Qi2.2 MagSafe Charger down at $99.74 shipped. Regularly $150, this is just over $50 off for the lowest price we can find.

This is, in fact, matching the Amazon all-time low, landing on par with the official Prime Day deal we featured a couple weeks back now. If you missed out there, here’s another shot at Amazon low pricing.

This model debuted earlier this year in February as the brand’s latest multi-function charging solution. More than robust enough to work as a traditional desktop 3-in-1 charging setup, it can also fold down into a palm-sized on-the-go option to take with you just about anywhere.

It boasts a max industry-standard 25W MagSafe pad as well as a pop-out Apple Watch charger around back, and, just beneath that, a wireless charing pad for your AirPods and the like.

  • 3-in-1 foldable MagSafe charger with 25W Qi2
  • Active Cooling “Cicada Wing” biomimetic airflow channels for “whisper-quiet 19 dB operation”
  • Total 25W power output across all three devices: iPhone, Apple Watch, AirPods
  • Qi2 certified with MagSafe-compatible magnetic alignment • Supports iPhone 17, 16, 15, and 14 series
  • iPhone: 25W max wireless charging

  • Beats woven USB-C cables down as low as just $6 each today
  • Go, go, go! This tool-free titanium Apple Watch band just plunged to $35 (Reg. $80)
  • Just $4 today gets you this 100W stealthy black zinc alloy braided USB-C cable (50% off)

Ultra-rare Prime Day deal still live live on latest black Apple Magic Mouse

Latest Powerbeats Pro 2 with Find My drop back down to rare all-time low at $70 off

Alongside Amazon still offering nearly 25% off the base AirPods 4 at $99, it has also decided to bring back the Prime Day all-time low on the latest Beats Powerbeats Pro 2 with Find My at close to 30% off.

Amazon is now offering Beats Powerbeats Pro 2 dow at $179.95 shipped in all four colors. That’s 28% off the regular $250 list price and the best deal we can find in brand new condition.

The $70 price drop we have on tap for the 4th of July is indeed on par with the lowest price we have tracked on Amazon. Having only dropped this low twice before today, you’re looking at a match for the best deal we have seen, landing back down at the same price we spotted for Prime Day last week.

While we do often see these earbuds down even lower in “excellent” open-box condition at Best Buy, and there are some options right now, they are not much lower than the rare $180 discount at Amazon today – some colors are even more.
